audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with millennium, abyss, throne, resurrection, judgment imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for binding of dragon, thousand years, first resurrection, final deception, great white throne, lake of fire. Non-sensational handling required.

verses.restored: And I saw a messenger descending from heaven, having key of abyss and great chain upon his hand.

familiar.text: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

modern.text: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss, holding in his hand a great chain.

original.text: Καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἔχοντα τὴν κλεῖν τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ ἅλυσιν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is slanderer and adversarial one, and bound him thousand years.

familiar.text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

modern.text: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

original.text: καὶ ἐκράτησεν τὸν δράκοντα, ⸂ὁ ὄφις ὁ ἀρχαῖος⸃, ὅς ἐστιν Διάβολος καὶ ὁ ⸀Σατανᾶς, καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν χίλια ἔτη,

verses.restored: He cast him into abyss, shut and sealed over him, so he might not mislead nations any longer until thousand years were completed; after these things he must be released a little time.

familiar.text: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

modern.text: And he threw him into the Abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him, so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete. After that, he must be released for a brief period of time.

original.text: καὶ ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον, καὶ ἔκλεισεν καὶ ἐσφράγισεν ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ, ἵνα μὴ ⸀πλανήσῃ ἔτι τὰ ἔθνη, ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη· ⸀μετὰ ταῦτα δεῖ ⸂λυθῆναι αὐτὸν⸃ μικρὸν χρόνον.

verses.restored: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them; and souls/lives of those beheaded because of witness of Jesus and word of Divine, and those who had not worshiped beast or image and had not received mark on forehead and hand; they lived and reigned with Messiah thousand years.

familiar.text: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

modern.text: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

original.text: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνους, καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐπʼ αὐτούς, καὶ κρίμα ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν πεπελεκισμένων διὰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ καὶ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ οἵτινες οὐ προσεκύνησαν τὸ θηρίον οὐδὲ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔλαβον τὸ χάραγμα ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτῶν· καὶ ἔζησαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν μετὰ τοῦ χριστοῦ ⸀χίλια ἔτη.

verses.restored: The rest of dead ones did not live until thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

familiar.text: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

modern.text: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.

original.text: ⸀οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔζησαν ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη. αὕτη ἡ ἀνάστασις ἡ πρώτη.

verses.restored: Blessed and holy is the one having part in first resurrection; over these second death has no authority, but they will be priests of Divine and Messiah and will reign with him thousand years.

familiar.text: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

modern.text: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years. Satan Cast into the Lake of Fire

original.text: μακάριος καὶ ἅγιος ὁ ἔχων μέρος ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῇ πρώτῃ· ἐπὶ τούτων ὁ δεύτερος θάνατος οὐκ ἔχει ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλʼ ἔσονται ἱερεῖς τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ χριστοῦ, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν μετʼ αὐτοῦ ⸀χίλια ἔτη.

verses.restored: When thousand years are completed, the adversarial one will be released from prison,

familiar.text: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

modern.text: When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison,

original.text: Καὶ ὅταν τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη, λυθήσεται ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐκ τῆς φυλακῆς αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: and will go out to mislead nations in four corners of earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for war; their number like sand of sea.

familiar.text: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

modern.text: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—to assemble them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the seashore.

original.text: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται πλανῆσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐν ταῖς τέσσαρσι γωνίαις τῆς γῆς, τὸν Γὼγ ⸀καὶ Μαγώγ, συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον, ὧν ὁ ἀριθμὸς ⸀αὐτῶν ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης.

verses.restored: They went up over breadth of earth and surrounded camp of holy ones and beloved city, and fire came down from heaven and consumed them.

familiar.text: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.

modern.text: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.

original.text: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸ πλάτος τῆς γῆς, καὶ ⸀ἐκύκλευσαν τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἠγαπημένην. καὶ κατέβη πῦρ ⸂ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ⸃ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτούς·

verses.restored: And the slanderer/adversary misleading them was cast into lake of fire and sulfur, where beast and false prophet also are, and they will be tested day and night into ages of ages.

familiar.text: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

modern.text: And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever. Judgment before the Great White Throne

original.text: καὶ ὁ διάβολος ὁ πλανῶν αὐτοὺς ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ θείου, ὅπου καὶ τὸ θηρίον καὶ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης, καὶ βασανισθήσονται ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

verses.restored: And I saw a great white throne and the One sitting on it, from whose face earth and heaven fled, and place was not found for them.

familiar.text: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

modern.text: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.

original.text: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνον μέγαν λευκὸν καὶ τὸν καθήμενον ⸂ἐπʼ αὐτοῦ⸃, οὗ ἀπὸ ⸀τοῦ προσώπου ἔφυγεν ἡ γῆ καὶ ὁ οὐρανός, καὶ τόπος οὐχ εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς.

verses.restored: And I saw dead ones, great and small, standing before throne; scrolls were opened, and another scroll opened, which is of life; dead ones were judged from things written in scrolls according to their works.

familiar.text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

modern.text: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And there were open books, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.

original.text: καὶ εἶδον τοὺς νεκρούς, τοὺς μεγάλους καὶ τοὺς μικρούς, ἑστῶτας ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, καὶ βιβλία ἠνοίχθησαν· καὶ ἄλλο βιβλίον ἠνοίχθη, ὅ ἐστιν τῆς ζωῆς· καὶ ἐκρίθησαν οἱ νεκροὶ ἐκ τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τοῖς βιβλίοις κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: Sea gave the dead in it, and Death and Hades gave the dead in them, and they were judged each according to their works.

familiar.text: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

modern.text: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.

original.text: καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡ θάλασσα τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἔδωκαν τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐκρίθησαν ἕκαστος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: Death and Hades were cast into lake of fire. This is second death, the lake of fire.

familiar.text: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

modern.text: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire.

original.text: καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἐβλήθησαν εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός. οὗτος ὁ ⸂θάνατος ὁ δεύτερός⸃ ἐστιν, ἡ λίμνη τοῦ πυρός.

verses.restored: And if anyone was not found written in scroll of life, one was cast into lake of fire.

familiar.text: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

modern.text: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.

original.text: καὶ εἴ τις οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν ⸂τῇ βίβλῳ⸃ τῆς ζωῆς γεγραμμένος, ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός.

translation_notes: Thousand years is apocalyptic-symbolic reign imagery; avoid rigid timeline wars in first pass.
Gog/Magog are symbolic enemies from Ezekiel tradition, not modern nation labels.
The final judgment is according to works and scroll of life; Death and Hades themselves are abolished.
safety_note: Do not use Revelation 20 for fear coercion, date-setting, or modern war-mapping. The symbolic endpoint is removal of deception, beastly power, Death, and Hades.
